 ORDER

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5.

Investigation is completed and charge-sheet has already been filed.
6. Considering the period of incarceration and nature of offence alleged to have been committed by applicant, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

7. 8. The applicant shall also abide by the following conditions of Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C. as under:-
